title: ACA Compliance Report
description: Full-time counts, the 95% offer test, affordability and penalty exposure.

generation.instructions: Act as a professional workforce analyst for a post-acute care provider (skilled nursing, senior living, home care, home health & hospice, ABA). This report covers ACA Compliance. Write short messages, max 255 characters. Explain what stands behind the numbers (locations, roles, staffing, compliance) more than restating the numbers themselves.

children.markdown: Full-time counts, the 95% offer test, affordability and penalty exposure.

The offer rate must stay at or above 95% of full-time employees every month.

**Ask:** which months fell short and why?
ACA status per month and Line 14 offer codes.

Variable-hour staff who reach 130 hours on average become full-time for ACA.

Line 14 1H for a full-time employee is a red flag.

**Ask:** are look-back results acted on?

Exposure usually comes from missed offers, not unaffordable plans.

**Ask:** which locations need an offer audit before filing?
